description: Etat d'avancement des Plans de Prévention des Risques Mouvements de Terrains (PPRMT) en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadata.carmen.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Communes of Île-de-France concerned by a Land Movement Risk Prevention Plan (PPRMT), attributing the type of procedure in progress and its state of progress.This table covers 3 types of procedures: prescribed or approved;- Risk Prevention Plan for Swelling Clay Removal (RGA): prescribed or approved;- Other procedure: R 111-3 (procedure described in article R111-3 of the ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Progress of Land Movement Risk Prevention Plans (PPRMT) in Île-de-France" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2014-01-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
